title: The Pilgrim
description:
“Will you lend your eye to me?
I’ll swim within your memory
Forgive my legibility
My master’s hand was frail and weak”
- translated and adapted from scraps of the lost

You have been visited by the Ancient.

The language of your kind has been forgotten.

Travel through the remains of a lost civilization.

Bring order to the symbols of the land.

Developed over the course of a year at DigiPen Institute of Technology, The Pilgrim is a reimagining of the classic “hidden object” genre of games. Each section holds something new to explore.

• Luscious 3D environments.

• A haunting soundscape.

• Many triangles.

• Something you haven’t seen before.

This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
description_short: Explore a strange and mysterious world, searching through the environment for symbols that will open the way forward.
